# xBRZ

xBRZ pixel-art scaler by Zenju, from the HqMAME project, licensed under the GNU General Public
License v3 (see the file headers). Copied from PPSSPP's `ext/xbrz`
(https://github.com/hrydgard/ppsspp/tree/master/ext/xbrz).

Local change: `xbrz.h` no longer includes PPSSPP's `ppsspp_config.h` (it only selected the
`<cstdint>` header).
